senses.gloss:
जव जव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. जु or जू), speed,
quickness, velocity, rapidity, swiftness; (अस्, आ, अम्),
swift, expeditious; (आ), f. the China rose, Hibiscus
Rosa Sinensis; [cf. जपा.]
—जव-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
possessed of fleetness.
—जव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, quick,
swift, fleet.
—जवाधिक (˚व-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, very
quick, extremely swift; (अस्), m. a fleet horse, a
courser.
—जवानिल (˚व-अन्˚), अस्, m. a strong
wind, gale, hurricane.
—जवा-पुष्प, अस्, m. the
China rose, the plant or its flower.

1. जवन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to hasten; quick,
swift, fleet; (अस्), m. a courser, a fleet horse; a kind
of deer; N. of one of the attendants of Skanda; (ई),
f. a screen surrounding a tent, a Kanāt; N. of a
plant; (अम्), n. speed, velocity; [cf. धी-जवन.]

जवन 2. जवन, अस्, m., N. of a people
whose country is by some thought to be identical
with Ionia or Greece, = यवन, q. v.

जवनिका, f. a wall or screen of cloth surrounding
a tent, an outer tent, &c.; a curtain, a screen in
general; the sail of a boat; [cf. यवनिका.]
जवनिमन्, आ, m. quickness, speed, velocity.

जवस्, अस्, n., Ved. quickness, velocity; [cf. अ-
जवस्.]

जविन्, ई, इनी, इ, quick, fleet, expeditious; (ई), m.
a horse, a camel.

जविन, अस्, आ, अम्, rapid, quick; (अस्), m. = को-
कड.

जविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. quickest, fleetest;
(अस्), m., N. of a Dānava.
जवीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. quicker, speedier.

जवनाल जवनाल, अम्, n. a sort of grain,
Andropogon Bicolor; [cf. यवनाल.]

जवस जवस, अस्, m. meadow or pasture
grass; [cf. यवस.]

जवादि जवादि, इ, n. a kind of perfume, =
कृत्रिम, गन्ध-राज.
जवाल जवाल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
जविपुला ज-विपुला, f. a kind of metre.

जावड जावड, अस्, m., N. of a man; [cf.
भावड.]

जावत् जा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing
offspring, granting offspring; (Sāy.) received by
praiseworthy persons (epithet of the Soma).

जावन्य जावन्य, अम्, n. (fr. जवन), quick-
ness, swiftness, rapidity.
